title: SAIC as contractor for psionic testing near Crane
place_text: SAIC; Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: thinks that saic which is located right next to Naval service Warfare crane was the contractor doing the psionic testing

plain: According to Jesse Michels, a person he calls only Sammy believes that SAIC, a large US defence contractor, was the company doing psionic testing, meaning tests of mind powers, for the government. Michels passes this on secondhand, noting that SAIC sits right next to Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana, and he names the physicist James Woodward in the same breath.
